name: ebay-etsy-marketplace-scraper-pro
title: eBay + Etsy Scraper Pro - Vintage Watches
description: Scrape eBay AND Etsy in one run — the world's two largest consumer marketplaces. Search for vintage watches, Pokemon cards, sports cards, vintage items, or any other product. Real prices in USD. Anti-bot bypass via Bright Data. 8 categories (luxury, vintage, Pokemon, sports cards, etc.). **NEW Phase 2: includeSold toggle returns 'last sold' comps for graded card deal detection.** Cheaper than yesintelligent Etsy scrapers ($3.50/1k vs $4.00/1k). Perfect for collectors, resellers, and price monitoring.

input.title: eBay + Etsy Marketplace Scraper Pro Input
input.description: Find ANY product on eBay and Etsy. Use Smart Search (NL) OR pick category presets.

smartSearch.title: Smart Search (recommended)
smartSearch.description: Type what you're looking for. The actor will detect brand, model, and price filters. Examples: 'Rolex Submariner', 'Seiko SKX007', 'Omega Speedmaster under $3000', 'vintage Omega Seamaster'.

presets.title: Category Presets
presets.description: Pick from 8 pre-built watch categories. Adds curated search terms for both eBay and Etsy.

enumTitles: Luxury Watches (Rolex, Omega, Tudor, Breitling, IWC, Patek)
Japanese Watches (Seiko, Casio, Citizen, Grand Seiko)

customSearchTerms.title: Custom Search Terms (optional)
customSearchTerms.description: Add your own search terms. Use exact model numbers for best results (e.g. 'Rolex 116610', 'Omega 311.30.42.30.01.005').

maxListingsPerQuery.title: Max listings per search query
maxListingsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of listings to extract per search query (5-200).

marketplaces.title: Marketplaces to search
marketplaces.description: Which marketplaces to scrape (eBay, Etsy, or both).

brightDataToken.title: Bright Data API Token (REQUIRED)
brightDataToken.description: Your Bright Data API token. Used to call web_unlocker1 zone which bypasses anti-bot. Get from https://brightdata.com/cp.

includeSold.title: Include sold listings (eBay only)
includeSold.description: When true, scrapes sold listings instead of active. Returns 'last sold' prices and sale dates. Useful for deal detection (compare current vs sold). Only works for eBay marketplace. Phase 2 feature (Sept 2026).
